main_body: A wooden chair seen from the front: a tall ladder-style backrest with two horizontal slats between side posts, a seat rail, and short legs. The seat is only a thin bar at the bottom.
top_band: none: the highest rows are the backrest top rail (light orange, about rows 1-3) which is a vertical face; the seat shows only as a 2px lighter bar around rows 10-11, with no horizontal surface visible from above
evidence: Reading down the middle column: back rail, slats and gaps, then a thin 1-2px seat bar and the dark legs. The seat has no foreshortened top band, so it reads as a flat front elevation of a ladder-back chair. It matches the red 'thin seat' guide: the seat surface is not seen from above.

style.evidence: The chair has about 3 wood tones (light orange, mid orange, dark brown) with a dark brown outline that follows the wood. Its slats and posts are mostly flat single-colour areas with almost no grain or dots. Each tile carries only a few colours, far less than the stall and well references, which have 5-6 steps and rich texture. It looks thinner and flatter than the references.
